title: AI Architect
jobDescription:
At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market.

What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers’ success and to our Winning Culture.

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, Linked In, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

About the Role

We're looking for a hands-on engineering leader to build and lead our Gen AI engineering team. You'll drive execution of our conversational AI and agentic AI roadmap, managing a team of talented engineers while remaining hands-on yourself. This role requires both exceptional leadership skills and the ability to roll up your sleeves and solve complex

technical problems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 7-10 Gen AI engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, innovation, and delivery
  • Drive end-to-end execution of conversational AI features that enable users to interact with Anaplan models through natural language
  • Oversee development of agentic AI systems that can autonomously analyze data, generate insights, and execute planning workflows
  • Own the team's delivery roadmap, working closely with product management to prioritize features and manage technical trade-offs
  • Establish engineering best practices for Gen AI development including testing strategies, evaluation frameworks and deployment patterns
  • Lead sprint planning, technical design reviews, and retrospectives to ensure consistent delivery velocity and quality
  • Collaborate with AI Solutions Architects to translate architectural vision into executable engineering plans
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for Gen AI applications, including automated testing and prompt regression suites
  • Partner with platform teams to ensure AI features integrate seamlessly with Anaplan's core infrastructure
  • Manage technical debt, refactoring initiatives, and platform improvements while maintaining feature delivery momentum
  • Recruit and onboard top engineering talent, conducting technical interviews and building a diverse, high-performing team
  • Communicate progress, risks, and technical decisions to senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience with 2+ years leading engineering teams
  • Strong hands-on experience building and deploying Gen AI applications in production
  • Deep knowledge of LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and conversational AI patterns
  • Experience with agentic frameworks and autonomous agent architectures
  • Proficiency in Python and modern software development practices (testing, code review, CI/CD)
  • Proven track record of delivering complex technical projects on time with high quality
  • Strong project management skills with experience using Agile/Scrum methodologies
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and build cohesive, productive teams
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading teams in fast-growing startups or enterprise software companies
  • Knowledge of financial planning, analytics, or business intelligence domains
  • Experience with RAG systems, vector databases, and semantic search
  • Familiarity with model fine-tuning, evaluation, and continuous improvement workflows
  • Background in distributed systems, microservices, or cloud-native architectures
  • Experience with Type Script/React for full-stack AI applications
  • Track record of improving engineering velocity and team productivity metrics

What Makes This Role Exciting

  • Lead a greenfield team building transformative AI capabilities from the ground up
  • Work on cutting-edge conversational and agentic AI technologies
  • Shape engineering culture and practices for Anaplan's AI organization
  • Join during a transformative phase as Anaplan embeds AI throughout its platform

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day!

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer

It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals.

Anaplan does not:

  • Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person.
  • Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication.

All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence.

Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

title: Alliances Director - Managed Services Partnerships
jobDescription:

The individual will play a leading role in alignment with the global partner strategy of Anaplan, serving as the Partner GTM lead for Managed Services Heritage firms (e.g., TCS, Wipro, Cognizant, Infosys). This role focuses on the global activation of these SI partnerships, working to incubate, establish, and grow strategic relationships from currently opportunistic ones, ensuring full alignment to set growth objectives.

Responsibilities

  • Grow Partner-Led Revenue: The core focus is building and growing partner-led revenue (both sourced and engaged) globally with Managed Services Heritage firms.
  • Incubate and Elevate Partnerships: Transform opportunistic relationships into established, growing, and strategic global partnerships.
  • Executive Alignment: Build, foster, and facilitate executive sponsorships and relationships to ensure close collaboration and support across key business stakeholders globally.
  • Enablement and Joint GTM: Onboard, enable, and build joint sales plays and offerings with strategic SI partners. Define clear strategic partner alignment to support sales, increase wallet-share in accounts by origination, and secure new customers.
  • Market Connection: Connect and establish local sales relationships across various global markets to drive demand generation and joint business opportunities.
  • Solution Development: Develop deep knowledge of Anaplan offerings and services to expand the partners' portfolio, creating differentiated joint solutions that broaden and deepen market coverage to build incremental revenue growth.
  • Performance Monitoring: Continuously review and develop global partnership engagements and services metrics, monitor performance, and implement appropriate plans to attain continued results.

Aptitude

  • Lead by example, advocate, and set appropriate expectations to foster strong global collaboration between Anaplan teams and go-to-market partners.
  • Provide effective leadership and management to ensure partners are highly engaged and delivering to set KPIs.
  • Ensure active communication of vision, priorities, and progress to the business to foster engagement, awareness, and motivation.
  • Ensure the provision of ongoing investment and development of partner resources; build up skilled and qualified customer success capabilities.
  • Contribute to continuous process improvement and sharing of best practices across global markets.
  • Awareness and understanding of the global regulatory framework in which the partners operate, ensuring adherence to Anaplan's policies, procedures, requirements, and compliance relevant to the role.

Ideal Candidate

  • Specific SI Experience: Deep knowledge of and prior experience working directly with Managed Services Heritage firms (e.g., TCS, Wipro, Cognizant, Infosys).
  • Global Navigation: Demonstrated ability to successfully navigate, execute, and build relationships in a cross-market global capacity.
  • Strategic Growth: Proven experience in building, growing, and executing strategic SI relationships and transforming opportunistic connections into strategic partnerships.
  • Saa S solutions experience.
  • Reputation as a thought leader and solid communicator of business value.
  • Strong connector, collaborative, and team-oriented.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Total of 12+ years in technology with significant relevant experience in sales and/or partner management.
  • Deep knowledge of the global System Integrators landscape, particularly Managed Services Heritage firms, including markets, solutions, and GTMs.
  • Outstanding track record of success in selling Saa S solutions.
  • Solid reputation as a thought leader and communicator of business value.
  • Proven track record of incubating, establishing, and growing strategic partner-led revenue (sourced and engaged) globally.
  • Open to global travel as required.

  • Bachelor's degree in business (Finance, Operations, Accounting, etc.) or highly technical field (Engineering, mathematics, data analytics, etc.)
  • Passion for business analytics, modeling, and planning

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Excellent verbal, written, and computer communication skills with strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Motivated self-starter
  • Experience working autonomously and collaboratively in a rapid-growth environment

Preferred Skills

  • End-to-end Anaplan deployment experience;
  • Consulting experience or academic research in a technical field (economics, engineering, science, math, etc.);
  • Experience collaborating on dynamic projects with HR, finance, accounting, product, and/or engineering teams;

jobDescription:

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

About the Role

As Manager of Data Operations, you will lead the day-to-day execution of Anaplan’s revenue data programs and support the health of our Go-To-Market (GTM) data ecosystem. You will manage a team of data operations specialists, partner closely with Sales, Marketing, and GTM Operations, and ensure the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of data across our GTM systems. This position reports to the Director of GTM Technology & Data Operations and plays an important cross-functional role in maintaining data quality standards and driving operational improvements. As this role supports global projects across AMER, EMEA, and APAC, the successful candidate will be required to work flexible hours to accommodate different time zones

Key Responsibilities

Data Strategy & Governance

  • Contribute to and execute against the data stewardship roadmap, supporting data ownership practices across GTM systems in alignment with direction from senior leadership.
  • Partner with stakeholders in Sales, Marketing, and IT to understand priorities and translate them into actionable data operations work.
  • Participate in cross-functional initiatives including territory planning, system migrations, and product launches, serving as the data operations point of contact.
  • Maintain and improve comprehensive documentation for data processes, governance standards, and system workflows.
  • Uphold data quality standards across GTM systems and work with cross-functional partners to address gaps and drive accountability.

Data Quality & Enrichment

  • Manage the execution of data enrichment programs, leveraging tools such as Zoom Info Ring Lead and D&B Connect to improve the completeness and depth of the GTM database. Coordinate with Marketing Operations.
  • Support the definition and monitoring of data quality SLAs in partnership with Sales, Marketing, and GTM Ops, tracking outcomes and escalating issues as needed.
  • Foster a proactive data quality culture through regular audits, cleansing routines, and ongoing stakeholder communication.
  • Participate in the enterprise data governance framework as a GTM data representative, helping to implement policy and maintain compliance standards alongside the global Data Governance team.

Data Operations Execution

  • Manage and continuously improve automation workflows for data management, including de-duplication, validation, and process automation in Salesforce and connected systems.
  • Execute data-driven database hygiene campaigns to maintain database integrity, reduce sales friction, and improve marketing segmentation effectiveness.
  • Prepare and share data quality reporting and operational status updates for stakeholders at the manager and director level.
  • Support the evaluation of data tooling and assist in managing vendor relationships; provide input on tool performance and usage.
  • Contribute to the data operations technology roadmap by identifying operational gaps and recommending solutions in partnership with leadership.
  • Identify opportunities for AI-assisted data operations using tools such as Gemini Enterprise, implementing automations that reduce manual effort and improve data quality.
  • Assist with tracking data operations spend and surface efficiency opportunities to leadership.

Team Leadership

  • Manage, mentor, and develop a team of data operations professionals; foster a collaborative, high-accountability team culture.
  • Support team members' professional growth through regular coaching, feedback, and performance conversations.
  • Coordinate team workload, set clear priorities, and ensure the team delivers against commitments on time and at quality.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of experience in data operations, data management, or business operations in a Saa S or technology company.
  • 2+ years of direct people management experience, with demonstrated success leading a data operations team or function.
  • Experience working cross-functionally and building productive relationships with peers in Sales, Marketing, and Operations.
  • Comfortable presenting data quality metrics and operational updates to manager- and director-level stakeholders.

Technical Skills

  • Core Data & CRM: Salesforce (Expert); SQL (proficient in querying, validation, and analysis)
  • Data Integration & Warehousing: Informatica; Reverse ETL tools; Google Big Query
  • BI & Reporting: Tableau
  • Data Enrichment & AI: Zoom Info Ring Lead; D&B Connect; Gemini Enterprise
  • GTM System Architecture: Familiarity with data flows for Marketing Automation Platforms (e.g., Marketo) and Sales Engagement Platforms (e.g., Outreach)
  • Scripting (Preferred): Python or similar scripting language for data automation and API integration
  • Advanced Excel skills (complex formulas, power queries, pivot tables)

Core Competencies

  • Operational Excellence: Proven ability to manage and improve data operations processes with measurable outcomes; comfortable working within established frameworks and escalating when needed.
  • Process Improvement: Experience implementing or refining processes around data stewardship, integrity, deduplication, and validation.
  • Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills to troubleshoot database issues and translate data findings into clear, actionable business insights.
  • Cross-Functional Communication: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to collaborate with peers, align stakeholders, and convey data topics clearly to non-technical audiences.
  • Vendor Coordination: Experience supporting vendor relationships and tracking tool performance and contract details.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Coupa Administrator to take ownership and provide strategic leadership for our Coupa ecosystem. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who is passionate about building a world-class Procure-to-Pay function. You will be the organization's foremost expert on Coupa, accountable for its performance, roadmap, and adoption.

A key part of your mission will be to act as a strategic and influential partner to the Procurement department, guiding them on best practices and shaping how the platform is run to maximize efficiency and value. You will also serve as the technical lead and mentor for our other team members who assist with Coupa operations, helping to elevate their skills and ensure operational excellence.

  • The role requires to work in the US shift to support US stakeholders (The latest end time for the shift will be around mid-night IST).

Key Responsibilities

  • Assume primary ownership of the Coupa platform, serving as the lead strategist responsible for its day-to-day stability and long-term strategic improvements.
  • Architect and implement end-to-end P2P solutions, driving the adoption of new features and managing platform release cycles.
  • Influence and guide the Procurement team on process optimization, ensuring the platform's configuration and usage align with strategic business goals.
  • Guide, mentor, and upskill team members
  • Serve as the escalation point for the most complex technical issues, including integration troubleshooting and advanced configuration challenges.
  • Maintain and optimize all core Coupa configurations (e.g., business rules, approval chains, chart of accounts, suppliers).
  • Proactively monitor and enforce data quality standards across supplier data, catalogs, and accounting structures.
  • Perform basic ad-hoc operational tasks in Workday Financials as needed to assist the wider finance team.
  • Create and own all documentation for processes, configurations, and best practices.

Qualifications & Experience

  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in a Coupa-focused role with a clear progression towards platform ownership and strategy.
  • Deep, expert-level knowledge of Coupa modules, including Procure-to-Order (P2O), and their underlying architecture.
  • Proven ability to influence and advise senior stakeholders and business partners, particularly within Procurement functions.
  • Strong understanding of system configuration, business rules, complex approval workflows, user roles, and integration points.
  • Experience mentoring or providing technical guidance
  • Excellent problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to work independently and lead through influence.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Significant experience with Coupa integrations, particularly with ERP systems like Workday Financials.

Your impact

The Infrastructure Capacity Data Analyst builds data models, dashboards, and predictive forecasting models to transform raw infrastructure metrics into actionable business intelligence. Leveraging strong data visualization expertise (specifically Power BI), you will build the automated reporting, forecasting models, and dashboards that allow engineering and leadership teams to make data-driven infrastructure decisions for both cloud and on-premises infrastructure.

You will also ensure we have enough resources to meet current and future Platform demand efficiently, involving forecasting needs, capacity planning, monitoring performance (KPIs), managing risks (shortages/overloads), and developing strategies for optimization.

You will :

  • Design, build, and maintain robust Power BI dashboards to track infrastructure utilization, capacity limits, and system performance KPIs.
  • Data Insights: Query and blend data from disparate technical sources (cloud billing, system monitoring tools, APIs) to create a single source of truth for capacity data.
  • Predictive Forecasting: Analyze historical usage trends and apply statistical methods to forecast future resource demands and flag potential capacity shortages or overloads before they impact users.
  • Translate complex infrastructure metrics into clear, executive-friendly reports and visualizations to help justify cloud spend and optimization strategies.

Your skills and experience

We work with a broad range of technologies, and we don’t expect you to know everything on day one. You’ll have time to learn our tools and grow into the role. We're looking for diverse experiences to help strengthen our team.

Essential

  • 5+ years of data analytics/DAX experience as a Data Analyst, Power BI Developer, or Business Intelligence Analyst, ideally in a Saa S environment
  • Proficient in SQL for data extraction and Power Query (M Code) for data transformation and cleansing.
  • Exception
  • A degree in computing or science is helpful but not essential
  • Understanding of current Capacity Management & Planning scenarios and tooling.
  • Experience with Agile principles and practices.

Desirable

  • Experience supporting Saa S products.
  • Experience and awareness of both cloud and on prem infrastructure practices
  • Knowledge of observability and monitoring best practices.
  • Experience operating within one or more public clouds (AWS, GCP, Azure)

Integrated Business Applications - Team Leader - India (15+ years)

Team Description

Anaplan applications are the strategic pillar of the Anaplan strategy, bringing best-in-class planning capabilities to our customers built on the Anaplan platform. As the Offshore Application Team Leader, you will establish and lead a new 25-person hub in India, providing a key capability for scaling our applications offering and serving as the vital bridge to our UK and US Centers of Excellence. This pivotal role delivers additional global capacity, flexible resource and is integral in taking our applications product organization to the next level.

Your Impact

Team Leadership & Development

  • Lead, inspire, and manage a newly established, high-performing offshore team of approximately 25 professionals, including Anaplan Model Builders, Solution Architects, QA engineers, and Product Owners.
  • Act as the primary onsite representative and leader in India, fostering a strong team culture aligned with global organizational values.
  • Drive line management, conduct performance evaluations, and actively mentor individuals to support their career progression.
  • Cultivate a strong "engineering mindset" within the team, ensuring that even without traditional software coding, the team applies rigorous, structural, and scalable thinking to model building.

Delivery Excellence

  • Oversee the end-to-end delivery and health of Anaplan application builds, ensuring projects meet strict quality, timeline, and budget expectations.
  • Establish and enforce robust QA and testing processes tailored to the Anaplan platform to minimize defects and technical debt.
  • Manage resource allocation, capacity planning, and prioritize workloads across multiple project streams to optimize the team's output.
  • Identify, escalate, and proactively mitigate delivery risks before they impact the business.

Technical Strategy & Collaboration

  • Serve as the critical, strategic interface between the offshore delivery center in India and the onshore Application Centers of Excellence (Co Es) based in the UK and US.
  • Translate onshore architectural visions and technical strategies into actionable delivery plans for the offshore team.
  • Facilitate seamless, daily collaboration across time zones, actively removing blockers and ensuring the offshore team has the context needed to succeed.
  • Align the offshore team's output with global Anaplan architecture guidelines and governance standards.

Platform & Product Mindset

  • Champion a product-centric approach to Anaplan application development, shifting the focus from mere task execution to delivering true business value.
  • Guide the team in understanding the broader business context and user needs behind the models they are building.
  • Ensure the adoption of Anaplan best practices throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Ensuring that the team focus on building broad configurable applications considering how different customers may have different needs for otherwise similar functionality

Your Qualifications

Leadership & Management

  • Proven track record of building, managing, and scaling technology or platform delivery teams (ideally 20+ members) in an offshore/nearshore model.
  • Extensive experience in line management, performance evaluation, and team motivation.

Technical Depth

  • Sufficient exposure to the Anaplan platform to thoroughly understand the context, challenges, terminology, and best practices of model building and architecture.
  • While hands-on Anaplan model building is not a requirement for this role, you must possess a strong technical intuition and the ability to fluently discuss architectural concepts with your Solution Architects.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise performance management (EPM) concepts or connected planning ecosystems.

Delivery & Process

  • Deep expertise in Agile delivery methodologies, sprint planning, and product management principles.
  • Experience establishing and refining software development lifecycles (SDLC) that are specifically tailored for platform-based configuration and building, rather than traditional custom code.
  • Demonstrated ability to implement rigorous quality assurance, peer-review, and testing standards.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to build trust and bridge geographical and cultural gaps with UK and US-based leadership teams.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to articulate complex delivery metrics, project statuses, and technical challenges to senior onshore stakeholders.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to context-switch between highly technical architectural discussions and high-level strategic updates.

Preferred Skills

  • Track record of building trust rapidly in new environments
  • Experience in enterprise performance management
  • Experience scaling systems and teams under high throughput demands
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and drive delivery without perfect information
  • Comfort with asynchronous collaboration and remote team dynamics
  • Previous experience running an Anaplan professional services, consulting, or center of excellence team

  • Develop end-to-end Gen AI features including backend API services, model integration, model monitoring, evaluations and deployments

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Machine Learning, or related field

  • Experience with model serving frameworks (v LLM, Tensor RT, Ray)
  • Background in forecasting, planning, or analytics applications
  • Familiarity with Anaplan or similar enterprise planning platforms
  • Experience with A/B testing and experimentation frameworks for AI features
  • Contributions to open-source ML projects or research publications

  • Strategic Service Leadership:You will not only lead major incident response but also own the continuous improvement of our service management framework. This includes independently running service improvement plans, identifying and resolving systemic gaps in our processes, and using your in-depth understanding of our platform architecture to proactively prevent future incidents.
  • Mentorship and Team Elevation:You will act as a subject matter expert and mentor, coaching peers and junior team members on ITIL/ITSM best practices, technical competencies, and process ownership. You will be responsible for coordinating team activities and ensuring the entire service management function operates effectively.
  • Owning Critical Customer Escalations:You will serve as a key point of contact during high-stakes situations, taking ownership of customer escalations and representing Anaplan with authority and confidence on customer calls. This includes participating in a 24/7/365 on-call rotation for both primary incidents and secondary escalations.
  • Leading Incident Management:You will command the end-to-end incident management lifecycle. This includes assessing and triaging technical events, managing communications during critical outages, and leading post-incident reviews (PIRs) to establish the root cause and prevent recurrence.
  • Driving Proactive Improvement:You will move beyond reactive fixes by defining, documenting, and refining core service management processes based on ITIL/ITSM principles. By analyzing operational data for trends, you will proactively detect and prevent future problems, build a knowledge-sharing environment, and create service improvement plans.
  • Serving as a Key Liaison:You will act as a crucial communication bridge between technical engineering teams, customer success departments, leadership, and customers. Your ability to provide clear, concise, and well-documented communications will be essential for managing expectations and ensuring compliance with customer Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

Your Qualifications

Essential

  • 5+ years of proven experience in Major Incident Management, Problem Management, and Relationship Management.
  • 5+ years of deep, practical experience working with ITIL principles and ITSM frameworks.
  • ITIL v4 or v3 certification.
  • A relevant university degree or equivalent professional industry experience.

Key Skills & Technologies

  • Deep expertise in ITSM concepts and tooling, particularly the Atlassian suite (Jira Software, Jira Service Management, Confluence), Statuspage, and Pager Duty.
  • Proven ability to lead projects, deliver service improvements, and mentor team members.
  • Advanced problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex situations with multiple variable factors and exercise sound judgment to drive resolution.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to own customer escalations and represent Anaplan effectively.

Desirable

  • Project Management certification (e.g., Prince 2).

  • Architect and ship React + Type Scriptfeatures with strongcomponent design,hooks, andperformancetuning (render paths, memoization, code splitting, lazy loading).

  • Define integration contracts for RESTand Graph QL; partner on BFFdesign, pagination, caching, and client-side mapping layers.
  • Advancemonorepopractices (pnpm,Nx): shared libraries, versioning, build graph optimization, and cross-package API stability.
  • Establish testing strategy:Vitest+RTLfor fast feedback;Cucumber+Playwright BDD E2E for critical journeys.

  • Leadproduction support: debug with Grafana,Splunk, distributed traces/logs; write actionable incident notes and preventative fixes.
  • Ownrelease to production: release trains, rollback judgment, coordination with SRE/platform,Harness/Argo CDpipelines.
  • Resolve Snyk,SAST, and dependency vulnerabilities; embed secure SDLC practices in team workflows.
  • Mentor junior/mid engineers via reviews, pairing, and technical RFCs; represent frontend in cross-team design reviews.

Core web (expert-level application)
  • Deep HTML/CSSskills applied through design systems, not ad-hoc styling.
  • Advanced Type Script(generics, discriminated unions, utility types, strict typing for API models).
  • Web Componentsliteracy (custom elements, shadow DOM, interoperability with React hosts where applicable).
React platform leadership
  • 5+ years building large, long-lived frontend products; 3+ years leading features in React.
  • Provenperformanceoptimization in data-heavy UIs (virtualization, debouncing, selector patterns, profiling).
  • Strongcomponent API design: composability, accessibility props, testability, and extension points.
Architecture & tooling
  • Production experience withmonorepos(pnpm,Nx), shared packages, and internal design libraries.
  • Viteand/or Webpackexpertise; familiarity withmodule federationandmicrofrontendoperational concerns.
  • Graph QLclient patterns (caching, error policies, colocated queries) plus robust RESTclient abstractions.
  • BFFcollaboration: shaping payloads for UI needs, auth/session handling at the edge of frontend concerns.
Quality, security & operations
  • Testing leadership:RTL+Vitest, meaningful coverage of behavior (not implementation detail); E2E strategy with Playwright/Cucumber.
  • Hands-onvulnerability remediation(Snyk, npm audits,SASTtriage) and secure dependency management.
  • Production debugging andobservability(Grafana,Splunk); SLO-aware mindset for customer-impacting defects.
  • CI/CD and release ownership (Git Hub Actionsor equivalent,Harness,Argo CD).

  • Track record mentoring engineers and raising code quality through reviews and standards.
  • Strong stakeholder communication (Jira, RFCs, estimations, risk callouts).
  • Experience taking features through full lifecycle including production rollout and post-release monitoring.

  • React Native+ native build/debug (Xcode/Android tooling) for shared mobile roadmap/ Next js
  • Storybook+ visual regression strategy for ADS consumers.
  • Feature flag frameworks and experimentation patterns.
  • Prior enterprise Saa S: multi-tenant UX, permissions, auditability, enterprise admin surfaces.
  • Experience withdrag-and-dropframeworks, canvas/SVG charting, and accessibility in non-standard widgets.

Your impact

Join our global Level 3 Support team. You'll resolve the most complex technical issues our customers face, combining deep technical expertise with exceptional customer support.   • Investigate and diagnose complex technical issues raised through support tickets
  • Build deep product knowledge across Anaplan’s platform and tools (including Grafana)
  • Collaborate with other teams to guide customers through complex technical solutions
  • Raise and track product bugs when you identify them
  • Communicate investigation progress and outcomes clearly to internal teams
  • Lead release reviews and onboard new product features to global support teams
  • Document detailed investigations and share technical knowledge within the team
  • Provide 24/7 emergency support for critical customer issues through our on-call rota
  • Work an adjusted schedule (for example, Tue-Sat or Sun-Thu) when needed to ensure global coverage

Your qualifications

  • Graduate or early-career professional with experience in data analysis (Excel or similar tools)
  • A degree in Mathematics, Physics, Electronic Engineering, Computer Science, or other technical disciplines involving large datasets
  • Fluent or professional proficiency in English

  • An analytical mindset with a methodical and detail-oriented approach
  • Able to thrive under time constraints in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

We’re looking for a Platform Infrastructure Engineer to join our Platform Infrastructure Operations Team in Gurugram. In this role, you will be responsible for the operational health, maintenance, and reliability of the Kubernetes infrastructure and in-cluster services that underpin Anaplan’s Saa S product offering.

You will focus on maintaining the stability and performance of our large-scale production environments. This includes participating in on-call rotations, responding to incidents, performing essential maintenance, and supporting our developer teams with Kubernetes related queries and asks. This is a hands-on role where you will work with a broad range of modern infrastructure technologies to ensure our platform is secure, resilient, and efficient. This role will report directly to the Engineering Manager.

Your Impact

  • Perform routine maintenance, upgrades, and patching across our Kubernetes clusters and in cluster services to ensure stability and security.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, performing root cause analysis and participating in incident/problem management processes.
  • Address and remediate security vulnerabilities within the platform in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with development teams, addressing queries and requests related to Kubernetes and infrastructure.
  • Contribute to automation efforts to reduce manual tasks and improve system reliability.
  • Develop and improve observability by developing dashboards and alerting within Grafana to drive improvements in MTTD and MTTR.

Your Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, mathematics, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Hands-on experience managing and supporting infrastructure in a Public Cloud environment (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Strong operational experience with Kubernetes in a production environment, including troubleshooting and maintenance.
  • A solid understanding of Linux system administration.
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code (Ia C) tooling such as Terraform.
  • Experience working in an operational context, including an understanding of incident management and on-call responsibilities.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Observability tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, or Open Telemetry.
  • Experience with Kubernetes in-cluster services like Ingress Controllers (e.g., Traefik, Ingress NGINX), Cert Manager, and a Service Mesh (eg. Istio).
  • Software development or scripting skills for automation (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash).
  • Experience with configuration management tools like Ansible.
  • Understanding of Agile/Kanban methodologies.

Job Description:


We are seeking a skilled Network Engineer to join our global team and help
design, implement, and maintain our private and public cloud infrastructure.
This role involves contributing to the maintenance and operation of network
components, with a focus on building smart, scalable, and easy to maintain
automated solutions.
The ideal candidate has experience working in a large-scale enterprise or
global cloud service provider network, with strong knowledge of networking
principles, and an understanding of networking in AWS, GCP and Azure. They
should also be comfortable working in a Linux environment, and proficient at
network automation and using configuration management and automation
tools such as Git and Ansible. They will possess a good awareness of the
network and communications ecosystem and of emerging technologies.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:
 Deploy, configure, maintain, troubleshoot and optimize network
infrastructure.
 Collaborate with senior engineers, architecture and engineering teams to
implement network requirements and support organisational objectives.
 Collaborate with external vendors and partners to maintain and continue
to improve the network.
 Contribute to network automation initiatives through the implementation
of scalable and intelligent automation solutions.
 Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure the stability and availability of our
critical infrastructure.


Required Skills & Experience:
 3+ years of experience in a network engineering role, ideally within a large-
scale enterprise or cloud service provider network.
 Strong knowledge of and working experience with network routing,
switching, and firewalling.
 Experience with modern data center network topologies such as spine-and-
leaf and overlay networks.
 Solid understanding of networking principles and concepts, including
working knowledge of common protocols such as Ethernet, IP (v4 and v6),
TCP, UDP, DNS, IPsec, BGP, VXLAN, EVPN, and HTTPS.
 Good proficiency in network security, and experience working with NGFW
firewalls.
 Good understanding of public cloud environments (Direct Connect, transit
gateway, VPCs, gateway etc.).
 Strong Grafana proficiency: building and maintaining custom metric
exporters and integrating externally provided exporters; designing
dashboards; and managing alerting configuration as code, deployed via
Terraform.
 Experience with VPN technologies.
 Network virtualisation such as VRFs and VXLAN.
 Ability to perform analysis of network performance and application issues
using standard diagnostics tools.
 Work remotely while collaborating closely with onsite engineers to support
network installations, troubleshooting, and maintenance as needed.
Desirable Skills (Nice to Have):
 Experience using and integrating DCIM & IPAM applications, such as
Device42, Infoblox etc with automation frameworks.
 Knowledge of DC networking technologies such as MLAG, Stacking.
 Experience with cloud providers such as Google Cloud and Azure.
 CCNA, CCNP, JNCIP-DC, Arista ACE:L3, or similar certification.
 Proficient working with Linux operating systems.
 Skilled in scripting (Python or Shell) and familiar with CI/CD practices.
 Understand concepts of Infrastructure-as-Code/Software.

We are seeking a proactive and experienced People Systems Program Manager to join our dynamic People Team. This role is crucial for supporting our People systems and enhancements and requires 5 – 7 years of hand-on experience with large HCM platforms and other HR systems. As a self-starter, you will be responsible for both the daily support and the strategic improvement of our People Team technology, acting as a key liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to drive successful outcomes.

Your Impact

As the People Systems Program Manager, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and optimizing our People systems and processes. Your work will directly contribute to the successful delivery of People systems initiatives, improve user experience, and ensure our People platforms evolve to meet business needs. You will have the opportunity to make a significant impact by transforming business requirements into effective, scalable solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and deliver the cross-functional People systems roadmap, directly enabling the success of the People and IT teams. Design and manage a centralized intake and prioritization process for all system enhancement requests, owning this significant process within the People team's project structure.
  • Proactively identify and solve People systems and data problems before they impact other teams. Use your deep expertise in HR processes and systems to translate vague requirements into practical, innovative solutions and clear functional specifications for the configuration team.
  • Partner with People Team stakeholders to gather requirements for new and existing systems enhancements and reports, while ensuring People data integrity and governance.
  • Coordinate and support implementation and management of our People systems and related internal tools.
  • Train end users and create collateral to target audiences
  • Support and maintain compliance activities by ensuring HR data, system configurations, and business processes align with internal controls and regulatory requirements.
  • Manage and support release cycles, including analyzing new features and advising People Team leaders and functional SMEs on potential benefits and considerations.

Your Qualifications

  • 5-7 years of experience in an HRIS, People technology, or related Program Management role.
  • Demonstrated ability to own and deliver cross-functional projects from start to finish, influencing peers and stakeholders to achieve desired outcomes.
  • Sought out for your ability to resolve ambiguity and proactively identify and solve complex problems before they escalate.
  • Experience acting as an autonomous owner of project deliverables and mentoring junior team members.
  • Strong experience with a major HCM platform and a deep understanding of core HR business processes.
  • Proven ability to translate business needs into functional requirements and system specifications.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to serve as a trusted and influential voice in planning discussions.
  • Must be able to work flexible hours to ensure overlap with the U.S. Eastern time zone.

Desired Skills and Attributes

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels.

They also ensure we have enough resources to meet current and future Platform demand efficiently, involving forecasting needs, capacity planning, monitoring performance (KPIs), managing risks (shortages/overloads), and developing strategies for optimisation.

You will :

  • Work with Engineering & Service Management to ensure that the disaster recovery and Capacity plans drive disaster recovery (DR) strategy and procedures both in Cloud and DC venues.

  • Regularly report Disaster Recovery activities.
  • Develop and implement capacity planning tooling, frameworks, policies, and strategies.
  • Provide capacity requirements and impact assessments for new services or changes.
  • Manage capacity deviations and implement improvement initiatives
  • Collaborate with other Platform managers to deliver objectives on our platform evolution roadmap.

Your skills and experience

We work with a broad range of technologies, and we don’t expect you to know everything on day one. You’ll have time to learn our tools and grow into the role. We're looking for diverse experiences to help strengthen our team.

Essential

  • 5+ years of experience in IT operations/Production Engineering.
  • Experience of Linux administration will be a day-one skill
  • Experience with Kubernetes administration
  • Being comfortable in a scripting language suitable for automation tasks
  • A degree in computing or science is helpful but not essential
  • Understanding of current recovery solutions and high availability architectures for cloud and on prem is needed.
  • Understanding of current Capacity Management & Planning scenarios and tooling.
  • Experience with Agile principles and practices.
  • Expertise in problem diagnosis across complex, distributed systems.

Desirable

  • Experience supporting Saa S products.
  • Experience with Incident Management, Post Mortems and related practices.
  • Knowledge of observability and monitoring best practices.
  • Experience operating within one or more public clouds (AWS, GCP, Azure).

You will drive the architectural vision for our deployment pipelines, cloud infrastructure, and operational reliability, ensuring our platform is scalable, secure, and highly available.

  • Infrastructure as Code (Ia C): Champion the use of Ia C methodologies (e.g., Terraform, Cloud Formation, Ansible) to ensure infrastructure is reproducible, easily managed, and fully automated.

  • Mentorship & Guidance: Act as a technical mentor and coach for senior, mid-level, and junior Dev Ops engineers. Elevate the technical baseline of the team through code reviews, architectural reviews, and best-practice advocacy.

  • Reliability & Performance: Drive Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles. Implement robust monitoring, alerting, and observability strategies using modern toolstacks (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk) to proactively identify and resolve bottlenecks.

  • Security & Compliance: Partner with the Information Security team to embed security into the CI/CD pipeline (Dev Sec Ops). Ensure infrastructure compliance with industry standards and best practices.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work hand-in-hand with development teams to ensure applications are designed for scale and operability from day one.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 10+ years of progressive experience in Dev Ops, SRE, or Software Engineering, with at least 3+ years functioning in a Principal, Staff, or Lead architect capacity.

  • Cloud Expertise: Deep, hands-on expertise with major public cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, and/or Azure) and their native services.

  • Containerization & Orchestration: Mastery of Kubernetes, Docker, and service mesh technologies (e.g., Istio) in large-scale production environments.

  • Automation & Ia C: Expert-level knowledge of Terraform, Ansible, Chef, or Puppet.

  • Scripting/Coding: Strong programming/scripting skills in Python, Go, Bash, or Java to build automation tools and integrate systems.

  • CI/CD Tools: Extensive experience with enterprise CI/CD platforms (e.g., Jenkins, Git Lab CI, Git Hub Actions, Spinnaker).

  • System Design: Proven track record of designing fault-tolerant, distributed systems and managing high-traffic, mission-critical applications.

  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience migrating monolithic applications to cloud-native microservices architectures.

  • Familiarity with Spring Boot and Java ecosystems.

  • Prior experience supporting infrastructure for AI/ML engineering or large-scale data platforms.

  • Advanced cloud certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Professional, Kubernetes CKA/CKS).

Your impact

As the Principal HA & DR Engineer, you will own the architectural strategy and technical execution for the platform's resilience, high availability, and disaster recovery lifecycle. You will design, build, and deliver technical solutions that support Platform availability, resiliency, and disaster response.

You will act as the principal authority for business continuity across our global infrastructure, defining the guardrails for system fault-tolerance and leading cross-functional coordination for multi-region disaster preparedness between both cloud and on prem. You will also design automated failover mechanisms, champion chaos engineering practices, and develop robust mitigation strategies to eliminate single points of failure across both cloud and on-premises infrastructure.

You will :

  • Drive the HA Strategy & Roadmap: Own the end-to-end design and technical execution of our global High Availability roadmap, ensuring continuous platform uptime across both cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Build & Implement HA Architectures: Hand-on code, configure, and engineer active-active clustering, global load balancing, and real-time database replication to completely eliminate single points of failure.
  • Establish the Resiliency Practice: Build and champion our foundational Resiliency Engineering framework from scratch, defining platform-wide standards for fault tolerance and self-healing.
  • Influence Engineering Teams: Partner with and influence cross-functional engineering squads to ensure self-healing mechanisms and automated recovery protocols are embedded directly into their core deliverables.
  • Bootstrap Chaos Engineering: Introduce and champion our first-ever Chaos Engineering program; you will define the strategy, establish the safe guardrails, and prepare the organization to execute its initial automated fault-injection and live-fire failover drills.
  • Build & Implement HA Architectures: Hand-on code, configure, and engineer active-active clustering, global load balancing, and real-time database replication to completely eliminate single points of failure.
  • Optimize Uptime & Manage Risks: Monitor infrastructure performance KPIs to identify potential bottlenecks, mitigate shortage or overload risks before they cause downtime, and ensure compliance with strict Customer SLA requirements.

Your skills and experience

We work with a broad range of technologies, and we don’t expect you to know everything on day one. You’ll have time to learn our tools and grow into the role. We're looking for diverse experiences to help strengthen our team.

Essential

  • 8+ Years of HA Engineering: Extensive HA experience across cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and on-premises environments.
  • Technical Influence: Proven ability to evangelize resiliency standards and influence cross-functional engineering teams to build self-healing features.
  • Failover & Replication: Hands-on expertise with real-time data replication, database clustering, and automated, zero-downtime traffic failover.
  • Infrastructure as Code (Ia C): Advanced proficiency with Terraform or Ansible to build and replicate highly available environments programmatically.
  • Systems & Container Engineering: Deep technical knowledge of Linux internals and container orchestration using Kubernetes (K8s).
  • Hybrid Network Engineering: Hands-on experience managing complex hybrid networking topologies, including BGP routing, DNS management, Anycast, and CDNs.
  •  Strategic Execution: Ability to translate high-level uptime requirements into a technical roadmap and personally execute the engineering work.

Desirable

  • Experience supporting Saa S products.
  • Experience with Incident Management, Post Mortems and related practices.
  • Knowledge of observability and monitoring best practices.
  • Experience operating within one or more public clouds (AWS, GCP, Azure).

About the Role

We're pioneering a new role focused exclusively on quality assurance for Gen AI systems. As our AI QA Engineer, you'll develop testing strategies, evaluation frameworks, and quality metrics specifically designed for LLM-powered applications. This role requires a unique blend of QA expertise, understanding of Gen AI behaviour, and automation skills

to ensure our AI features are reliable, accurate, and trustworthy

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and implement comprehensive testing strategies for Gen AI features including conversational AI, agentic systems, and LLM-powered workflows
  • Develop automated test suites for prompt testing, including regression tests that detect unintended changes in model behaviour
  • Create evaluation frameworks to measure Gen AI quality across multiple dimensions (accuracy, relevance, safety, consistency, latency)
  • Build and maintain test datasets and golden examples that represent diverse user scenarios and edge cases
  • Implement monitoring and alerting systems to detect quality degradation in production Gen AI features
  • Perform adversarial testing to identify potential failures, hallucinations, biases, or security vulnerabilities in AI systems
  • Collaborate with engineers to define acceptance criteria and quality gates for AI feature releases
  • Develop tools and frameworks that make it easy for engineers to test their Gen AI implementations
  • Conduct user acceptance testing and gather feedback on AI feature performance from internal users
  • Document testing procedures, known issues, and quality metrics in clear, accessible formats
  • Partner with Product and Design teams to ensure AI features meet user experience standards
  • Stay current with Gen AI testing methodologies, tools, and industry best practices

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of QA or test engineering experience, preferably with AI/ML systems.
  • Strong understanding of Gen AI technologies including LLMs, prompt engineering, and AI application patterns
  • Experience with test automation frameworks and scripting (Python, Java Script, Selenium, Pytest)
  • Knowledge of software testing methodologies (functional, integration, regression, performance, security testing)
  • Ability to design test cases and evaluation criteria for non-deterministic systems
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
  • Experience with API testing tools (Postman, REST Assured) and backend testing
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing integration
  • Excellent communication skills for documenting issues and collaboration

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience testing conversational AI, chatbots, or agentic systems
  • Knowledge of ML model evaluation metrics and techniques
  • Familiarity with LLM evaluation frameworks (Lang Smith, Prompt Foo, Ragas)
  • Experience with performance testing and load testing AI APIs
  • Understanding of responsible AI principles including fairness, transparency, and safety testing
  • Background in enterprise software or Saa S QA
  • Experience with test management tools (Test Rail, Zephyr, Jira)
  • Knowledge of security testing methodologies for AI systems
  • Scripting experience with Python, including working with LLM APIs

What Makes This Role Exciting

  • Define QA practices for Gen AI applications
  • Work on cutting-edge AI technologies and help ensure they're reliable and trustworthy
  • Shape quality standards that will impact millions of enterprise users
  • Collaborate closely with engineers, data scientists, and product teams
  • Grow expertise in a highly specialized and increasingly important domain

    • Functional & technical specifications
    • Challenge stakeholders to refine unclear or suboptimal requirements
  • Hands on Salesforce objects, flows, validation rules, layouts
    • CPQ configuration (products, pricing rules, discounting, bundles)
    • Basic Lightning components (LWC exposure preferred, not heavy dev)
    • Reports, dashboards, and data models
    • Troubleshoot issues across systems and integrations
  • Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders for UAT execution
    • Defect tracking and prioritization
    • Business validation and signoffs
  • Drive release readiness, rollout, and adoption

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

  • Own intake and prioritization framework for GTM enhancements
  • Improve:
    • Data quality
    • Process compliance
    • System adoption

What you bring

  • 6–10+ years in Salesforce ecosystem (Sales Cloud + CPQ)
  • Proven experience owning end-to-end Lead-to-Cash lifecycle
  • Ability to operate as:
    • Strategic thinker (architect mindset) AND
    • Hands-on executor (configuration + testing)
  • Strong experience in UAT planning, execution, and release governance
  • Deep understanding of:
    • CPQ complexity (pricing rules, bundles, approvals)
    • Sales processes (pipeline, forecasting, deal desk)
    • Pricing & packaging strategies
    • Customer lifecycle (acquire → expand → renew)
  • Familiarity with:
    • Gainsight (or CS platforms)

What you’ll be doing:
As a Senior Security Engineer embedded within the Security Operations team,you will design, build, and continuously improve the technical capabilities that underpin how we detect, investigate, and respond to threats. You will work at the intersection of engineering and operations — turning security problems into scalable, automated solutions. Your core responsibilities will be to:

  • SIEM Engineering: Own the engineering of our SIEM platform, includingonboarding and normalizing log sources, building and maintaining,parsers, and ensuring high-fidelity data pipelines that underpin, detection and investigation. Work to continuously improve log coverage,data quality, and platform performance.
  • Detection Engineering: Design, develop, and maintain a library of high-quality detections using a Detection as Code methodology — managingdetection content through version control, peer review, and automated, testing pipelines. Map detections to the MITRE ATT&CK framework and work to continuously improve coverage, precision, and resilience
    against evasion.
  • SOAR & Automation: Build and maintain automated workflows and playbooks using SOAR platforms to streamline alert triage, enrichment, and response. Identify manual and repetitive processes across the security operations lifecycle and engineer solutions that allow the team to operate at scale.
  • AI-Augmented Security Operations: Explore and operationalize the use of AI and machine learning to enhance security operations capabilities— including alert triage, incident response acceleration, threat intelligence analysis, threat hunting, and the enrichment and prioritization of detection content. Evaluate emerging AI tooling and work to embed it responsibly into team workflows.
  • Threat Intelligence Integration: Consume and operationalize threat intelligence from internal and external sources, integrating indicators and adversary context into detection logic, SOAR playbooks, and hunting activities. Work with threat intelligence feeds and platforms to ensure actionable intelligence flows into security operations in a timely
    and structured way.
  • Threat Hunting: Conduct proactive, hypothesis-driven threat hunts across the environment to identify attacker activity that evades existing detections. Document and share findings in a structured way, using hunt outcomes to directly inform and improve detection engineering and tooling.
  • Incident Response Support: Provide engineering-level support during security incidents, assisting with investigation, containment, and recovery. Contribute to post-incident reviews and translate lessons learned into improved detections, playbooks, and tooling.

What you’ll bring to the ROLE:
We are looking for a technically strong security professional with hands-on experience building and operating security capabilities in complex
environments. The ideal candidate will possess:

  • Technical Security Experience: Significant experience in a security engineering, Dev Sec Ops, or equivalent role with a strong background in securing cloud-native environments and modern application stacks.
  • Detection & Response Skills: Practical experience developing and tuning SIEM detections, writing threat hunting queries, and participating in
    incident response activities.
  • Sec Ops Tooling: Hands-on knowledge of administering and operating core security operations tools, including SIEM platforms (e.g. Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel), EDR/XDR solutions, vulnerability scanners, and ticketing or case management systems. Experience integrating these tools to support detection, investigation, and response workflows.
  • Threat Intelligence & Threat Hunting: Experience working with threat intelligence platforms and feeds (e.g. MISP, Recorded Future, Virus Total), and integrating intelligence into security tooling, detection logic, and operational processes. A working knowledge of threat hunting methodologies and the ability to proactively identify indicators of
    compromise or attacker behavior across the environment is highly desirable.
  • Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in one or more scripting or programming languages (e.g. Python, Go, Bash) to build security tooling,
    automate workflows, and integrate security capabilities.
  • Application Security Knowledge: Familiarity with secure development practices, OWASP top risks, and the ability to perform code reviews or
    work with developers to remediate security findings.
  • Security Frameworks & Standards: Working knowledge of relevant security frameworks (e.g. NIST CSF, CIS Benchmarks, MITRE ATT&CK) and compliance standards such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
  • Communication & Collaboration: Strong ability to articulate technical security risks and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and to work cross-functionally to deliver security outcomes.
  • Incident Response & Digital Forensics: Hands-on experience leading or supporting security incident investigations, including evidence preservation, log and artifact analysis, timeline reconstruction, and root cause identification. Familiarity with forensic tooling and methodologies is highly sought after, as is experience contributing to post-incident
    reviews and translating findings into actionable improvements.

  • Proficiency in orchestrating data pipelines with Airflow.
  • Strong programming skills in Python.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with RESTful APIs and/or Graph QL.
  • Demonstrated experience in a technical leadership or mentorship role.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field.
  • Experience building and maintaining component libraries or design systems.

Senior Infrastructure Engineer – Certificate Management

As a Senior Infrastructure Services Engineer specialising in Certificate Management, you will play a key role in designing, operating, and evolving our enterprise certificate management platform. This platform supports thousands of certificates across a global multi-cloud and on-premise environment.

You will focus on building a scalable, automated, and sustainable certificate management capability that enables service teams to manage their certificates through self-service workflows while ensuring strong governance, security, and visibility across the organisation.

Working closely with domain architecture, security, and platform teams, you will help define and implement the future state of certificate lifecycle management, automation, and observability.

The long-term objective of this role is to minimise manual certificate operations by engineering automation, self-service capabilities, and platform integrations that allow service teams to securely manage certificate lifecycles at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Design, implement, and operate the organisation’s central certificate management platform supporting both public and internal certificates.

Work with architecture and security teams to define and implement enterprise standards for certificate lifecycle management, including issuance, renewal, revocation, and domain control validation (DCV).

Engineer automation that enables scalable and sustainable certificate operations across thousands of certificates in multi-cloud and on-prem environments.

Develop integrations and automation workflows to support automated certificate issuance, renewal, and lifecycle management.

Implement certificate discovery and inventory capabilities to ensure full visibility of certificates deployed across the environment.

Build supporting automation and integrations using scripting and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Python, Terraform, and Ansible.

Enable service teams to manage certificates through federated self-service capabilities while maintaining central governance and policy enforcement.

Improve observability of certificate health and lifecycle status through metrics, logging, dashboards, and alerting.

Integrate certificate lifecycle monitoring into the organisation’s observability stack.

Partner with platform, infrastructure, and service teams to integrate certificate lifecycle processes into service delivery workflows.

Troubleshoot and resolve complex certificate lifecycle issues and drive improvements that reduce manual operational effort.

Maintain clear documentation, architectural diagrams, and operational runbooks for the certificate management platform.

Continuously evolve the platform to support changing industry requirements such as shorter certificate lifespans and updated domain validation processes.

Validate certificate signing requests and TLS certificate contents using tools such as openssl to ensure compliance with modern certificate standards and prevent issuance errors.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience working in infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, or site reliability roles.

Strong understanding of TLS/PKI fundamentals and certificate lifecycle management.

Experience operating or integrating with enterprise certificate management platforms.

Experience developing automation and integrations using scripting or programming languages such as Python or similar.

Practical experience automating infrastructure or operational workflows using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, or comparable automation frameworks.

Experience working in distributed infrastructure environments spanning cloud and on-premise platforms.

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in complex production environments.

Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including security, platform engineering, and service owners.

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

Desired Skills

Experience working with certificate lifecycle management platforms such as App View X, Sectigo, or Cyber Ark.

Experience integrating with public certificate authorities such as Digi Cert, Let’s Encrypt, SSL.com, or Global Sign.

Experience implementing automated certificate lifecycle workflows using protocols such as ACME, EST (Enrollment over Secure Transport), or SCEP (Simple Certificate Enrollment Protocol).

Experience managing distributed certificate authorities, certificate revocation lists (CRLs), and Online Certificate Status Protocol (OCSP) services.

Experience with private certificate authorities such as AWS Private CA, Hashi Corp Vault CA, or Microsoft Certificate Services.

Knowledge of different types of certificates used in enterprise environments and their use cases (e.g., TLS/SSL, m TLS, client authentication, service-to-service communication).

Experience with observability platforms such as Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, or Elastic Search/Open Search.

Experience supporting infrastructure across multi-cloud and on-premise environments.

Experience working with containers and container orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes.

Working knowledge of Linux systems and operating environments.

Experience validating certificate signing requests and certificate metadata using tools such as openssl.

Understanding of industry trends impacting certificate lifecycle management, including shorter certificate lifetimes and evolving domain control validation requirements.

  • Define project scope, success criteria, timelines, and resource requirements in collaboration with IT leadership
  • Coordinate with platform owners, vendors, and internal teams to ensure delivery alignment across all active workstreams
  • Maintain a consolidated view of portfolio health, surfacing dependencies and conflicts proactively

Governance and Reporting

  • Produce executive-ready project status updates, steering committee materials, and program dashboards
  • Ensure projects adhere to established intake, scoring, and lifecycle governance processes, applying AI Readiness Program standards to applicable Enterprise AI workstreams
  • Maintain documentation standards across all managed initiatives, including project charters, decision logs, and closure reports
  • Deliver structured stakeholder communications on a recurring cadence: weekly status updates for active workstreams, monthly program summaries for IT leadership, and quarterly reviews for executive and cross-functional stakeholders

Stakeholder and Change Management

  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with stakeholders across IT, business functions, and external vendors
  • Support change management activities including communications planning, training coordination, and adoption tracking in partnership with the People and Communications teams
  • Act as a trusted point of contact for project stakeholders, proactively managing expectations and ensuring alignment at every phase

QUALIFICATIONS:

Required

  • 6 to 9 years of experience in technical project management within an enterprise IT environment
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex, cross-functional programs with multiple concurrent workstreams
  • Strong command of Agile and sprint-based delivery methodologies, with hands-on experience running sprint ceremonies and managing iterative delivery cycles alongside Waterfall or hybrid approaches
  • Proficiency with project and work management platforms such as Service Now, Wrike, Jira, or equivalent
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with experience producing materials for senior and executive audiences
  • Proven ability to manage ambiguity, navigate organizational complexity, and maintain delivery momentum without direct authority
  • Ability to work in a hybrid, globally distributed team environment with availability to maintain core working hour overlap through at least 12:00 PM EST to support cross-regional collaboration

Preferred

  • PMP, PMI-ACP, or equivalent project management certification
  • Familiarity with IT service management (ITSM) frameworks, particularly Service Now
  • Exposure to AI program governance, adoption tracking, or enterprise AI rollouts
  • Experience supporting change management or internal communications workstreams as part of broader program delivery
  • Prior experience in a Saa S, technology, or high-growth enterprise environment

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Scrum Master to act as a hands-on agile leader, mentor, and performance coach within our Gurugram, India office. This role is a unique blend of deep team facilitation and agile community leadership. You will be embedded within some of our engineering development teams, guiding them to peak performance, while also serving as the local agile expert and mentor a Scrum Master Chapter.

If you are a master of your craft, passionate about developing others, and ready to make a systemic impact on our agile culture, this is the perfect opportunity to advance your career.

Key Responsiblities

  • Lead engineering teams as their dedicated Scrum Master, modelling advanced agile practices and fostering a culture of accountability and high performance.
  • Empower the team to run their own team ceremonies by providing the necessary support, tools, and guidance. Acting as a supportive figure to ensure meetings become team-led, productive, and value-driven
  • Partner with Product Owners and tech leads to champion advanced backlog management, prioritization techniques, and goal setting that maximizes business value.
  • Drive a relentless focus on continuous improvement, using data and metrics to help your teams become more predictable, efficient, and self-sufficient.
  • Act as a coach and mentor to a Scrum Master Chapter, providing guidance, support, and an escalation path for complex challenges.
  • Lead a local Community of Practice for Scrum Masters to foster knowledge sharing, collaborative problem-solving, and the standardisation of best practices.
  • Partner with leadership by contributing to the performance evaluation of the Scrum Masters you mentor, providing constructive feedback to help them grow.
  • Lead Large-Scale Planning: Play a key role in the planning, organization, and facilitation of large-scale planning events (e.g., Big Room Planning), ensuring all teams are aligned and committed to a shared set of objectives.
  • Take a leading role in identifying, managing, and resolving complex, cross-team dependencies and risks that impact delivery.
  • Develop and manage relationships with senior stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor on agile principles, delivery forecasting, and expectation management.

Your Qualifications

  • Extensive Experience: Min 7 years of dedicated and proven experience as a Scrum Master or Agile Coach, with a clear track record of success in maturing teams and improving delivery outcomes.
  • Hands-On Practitioner: You are not a theorist. You have deep, practical, "in-the-trenches" experience with all facets of agile practices and are comfortable demonstrating 'how' as well as explaining 'why'.
  • Advanced Agile Knowledge: You have a deep understanding of the principles behind Scrum, Kanban, and other agile methodologies, and you know when and how to apply them to get results.
  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent certification is desirable.
  • Experience in Large-Scale Planning: Proven experience facilitating large, multi-team planning events (like PI Planning, Big Room Planning) and driving them to successful outcomes.
  • Proven Mentorship Ability: Demonstrable experience formally or informally coaching and mentoring other Scrum Masters or agile practitioners to help them grow their skills.
